title: Sabun Kecil dari Tiap Kota
mood: hangat, sabar, rindu yang tenang (warm, patient, quietly missing him)
subject: In their first rented house in Sidoarjo, a wife lines the bathroom shelf with the hotel soaps her husband, a travelling generator technician, brings home from every town, reads his month from the wrappers, and never unwraps the one from their honeymoon in Batu.
caption: Indonesian pop-country with a train-beat shuffle. Boom-chick strummed acoustic guitar, five-string banjo in soft rolling arpeggios, fiddle answering the vocal with double-stop fills, pedal steel in long swells behind the chorus, upright bass with brushed snare. warm close-miked live-room country mix with natural room reverb. Female vocal, warm mid register, conversational storytelling delivery, clearly sung. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 96 BPM, G major. Warm, patient, quietly missing him. No rap, no autotune, no trap hi-hats, no EDM synths, no electric guitar distortion.
lyrics:
[Intro - banjo arpeggios, soft fiddle]
[Verse 1]
Rumah kontrakan kita di Sidoarjo
Rak kamar mandi sempit, tapi penuh
Sabun kecil dari hotel tiap kota
Kamu bawa pulang dalam saku jaket
[Pre-Chorus]
Aku baca bulanmu dari bungkusnya
Gresik, Madiun, Kediri, Tuban
[Chorus]
Sabun kecil dari tiap kota
Kususun rapi di rak sebelah cermin
Kalau rindu datang, kuhirup baunya
Kutahu kamu masih jalan pulang
[Verse 2]
Teknisi genset keliling Jawa Timur
Pulang seminggu, pergi lagi besok
Tasmu berbau solar dan kopi sachet
Tapi sakumu selalu ada oleh-oleh
[Pre-Chorus]
Aku tak pernah bilang aku menunggu
Cuma kuganti handuk setiap Jumat
[Chorus]
Sabun kecil dari tiap kota
Kususun rapi di rak sebelah cermin
Kalau sepi datang, kuhirup baunya
Kutahu kamu masih jalan pulang
[Chorus]
Sabun kecil dari tiap kota
Yang di Batu tak akan kubuka
Biar wanginya tinggal di bungkus
Sampai kamu pulang, kita buka berdua
[Outro - banjo and fiddle fade]
Sampai kamu pulang
